input_context.prompt: Run an audit that returns immediately and verify its timeout watchdog does not outlive the audit.

response_text: Defective observation: audit-run.sh killed only the watchdog subshell. Its sleep child was reparented, stayed alive for the 1800-second timeout, held the captured stdout pipe open, and tests/decision-events.bats timed out. Corrected regression: audit-run leaves no timeout watchdog behind after it returns; leaked PIDs in the test process group are empty and the audit verdict exists.
